terra.problem: “Joshua burns Hazor” says Hazor was the only city burned, but Joshua 11:13 limits that comparison to cities built on their mounds. The passage should also extend through verse 13 to support this detail.
“A warning about Hazor” concerns a different Hazor, a district associated with Kedar, not the northern city featured on this card.
Words and phrases such as “oppressed,” “captives,” and “a desolation forever” may be difficult for a fifth-grade reader. Simpler wording would make the card easier to read.
